Hi Elena —

Thanks for sharing the usage snapshot this morning. I pulled the Q2 numbers and it looks like Novum has crossed the 2.5x baseline we agreed on at renewal. Good news — growth is great — and we want to make sure your apps stay performant without surprises.

Two things I want to align on so we can move fast for procurement:
- Option A: Uplift the committed capacity for the remainder of the contract quarter-by-quarter with a 12% uplift over baseline (pro-rated invoicing).
- Option B: Mid-contract purchase for additional reserved capacity with a 9% unit discount vs list and co-term the new capacity to your existing Mar 31 renewal date (single invoice).

I attached the usage CSV and a short spreadsheet that models both options and the expected monthly invoice impact. If you prefer, we can also do a blended pricing approach.

Can you confirm which procurement flow you prefer (pro-rate vs co-term) and whether procurement needs a PO before we send a formal quote?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20m call if that helps.

— Soojin
